json.notes: Victorian white timber and glass conservatory. A central two-stage domed pavilion (drum, glazed dome, finial) sits at the middle with a lower dome ring around it. Two long low glazed wings with curved vault roofs run left and right, each ending in a smaller dome pavilion with a spire. A low brick base runs under the glass. A small entrance porch sits at the front, and a grass lawn lies in front.
